name: GLONASS Precise Ephemeris (IAC SP3) Data Source
description: Executable data-source (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only, no JSON and no hostcalls but plugin.getConfig): request turns a TimerTick into the GET HttpRequest of an IAC GLONASS precise ephemeris (SP3-d, config sourceUrl); hostcap/http-request fetches it; emit turns its HttpResponse into one SDS $OEM per GLONASS satellite (position-only, frame and time system AS DECLARED in the SP3 header, NORAD 0), at most config objectCap when positive, consumed in memory by analysis/od.fit and never stored. A transport error, a status other than 200, an empty body or a file without position records fails closed. Nothing is stored, signed or published.

methods.displayName: Request the IAC GLONASS precise ephemeris (SP3-d)
methods.description: A TimerTick -> one GET HttpRequest for the IAC GLONASS precise ephemeris (SP3-d) (config sourceUrl, default IAC's ftp latest Final.sp3; the host's http connector must support the scheme), for hostcap/http-request. The flow's trigger sets the cadence; the provider's suggested one is every 12 h (the former module timer glonass-pull).

acceptedTypeSets.description: The flow trigger firing (TimerTick, TICK); its fields are not read.

inputPorts.description: The flow trigger firing (TimerTick, TICK); its fields are not read.

acceptedTypeSets.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) for the IAC GLONASS precise ephemeris (SP3-d).

outputPorts.description: One GET HttpRequest (HREQ) for the IAC GLONASS precise ephemeris (SP3-d).

methods.description: The HttpResponse of the SP3 GET -> one $OEM per GLONASS satellite (config objectCap bounds them).

acceptedTypeSets.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for the IAC SP3: STATUS 200 with BODY the file verbatim.

inputPorts.description: The HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for the IAC SP3: STATUS 200 with BODY the file verbatim.

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $OEM ephemerides (position-only, as declared), one per satellite, for analysis/od.fit; never stored.

outputPorts.description: SDS $OEM ephemerides (position-only, as declared), one per satellite, for analysis/od.fit; never stored.

sequentialJustification.detail: Each method turns one frame into the next request or the parsed ephemeris on the calling thread; the host parallelizes independent sources and this module creates no threads.
